description: This file defines a report parser class for auction total reports in an Odoo/OpenERP module, including methods for aggregating auction data and generating report context.

classes.name: auction_total_rml
classes.description: A report parser class for auction total reports, providing methods to fetch and compute auction data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and sets up the local context with various data aggregation methods.

methods.name: get_auc_detail
methods.description: Retrieves auction details for a list of objects, including auction dates and IDs.

methods.name: sum_taxes
methods.description: Counts the number of auction lots for a given auction ID.

methods.name: sold_item
methods.description: Counts the number of unsold auction lots for a given object ID.

methods.name: sum_buyer
methods.description: Counts buyers associated with an auction ID.

methods.name: sum_seller
methods.description: Counts distinct sellers for an auction ID.

methods.name: sum_adj
methods.description: Sums the object prices for an auction.

methods.name: count_take
methods.description: Counts auction lots with 'ach_emp' marked as True for an auction.

methods.name: chek_paid
methods.description: Counts auction lots that are marked as paid or OK.

methods.name: check_paid_seller
methods.description: Sums seller prices for lots not marked as paid to seller.

methods.name: sum_credit
methods.description: Sums buyer prices for an auction.

methods.name: sum_debit_buyer
methods.description: Sums buyer prices for an auction, defaulting to 0 if None.

methods.name: sum_debit
methods.description: Sums seller prices for a given auction ID.

methods.name: sum_credit_seller
methods.description: Sums seller prices for a list of objects in an auction.

methods.name: sum_minadj
methods.description: Sums estimated minimum lot values for an auction.

methods.name: sum_maxadj
methods.description: Sums estimated maximum lot values for an auction.

methods.name: sum_buyer_paid
methods.description: Counts lots with 'paid' status for an auction.

methods.name: count_comm
methods.description: Counts lots with non-null commission for an auction.
